correctness.rationale: Derivations are determined by their e1,e2 images through [e1,e_j]=e_{j+1}; the zero bracket [e2,e3]=0 forces b1=0 and comparison of both e_n bracket representations forces a2=a1-b2. For zero brackets [e2,e_j], the central constraints are precisely 2b_4=2b_6=...=2b_(2m-2)=0, leaving m-2 extra parameters only at p=2. Their remaining relations are checked by the central bracket coefficient calculation and the triangular recursion. The diagonal of D is a1, b2, ja1+b2 (j=1..2m-3), and (2m-3)a1+2b2. With a1 nonzero, distinct forbidden projective slopes number min(p,2m-1): two for p=2 and 2m-1 if p>2m-3. This proves all finite-field counts with q^(d-2) free fiber. Independent full derivation-condition matrices and Lie Jacobi checks for n=6,8,10 over p=2,3,5,7 reproduce ranks and diagonal determinant; bounded checks are not the all-m proof.

final_claim: For the defined naturally graded filiform Lie algebra Q_{2m}(k), m>=3, Der has dimension 3m in characteristic !=2 and 4m-2 in characteristic 2. Over finite F_q of characteristic p the exact number of invertible derivations is q^(d-2)(q-1)(q-min(p,2m-1)), including the sharp prime-field obstruction and proper-extension existence.
